title: Homestead Campground

services.name: 4-Person Cabins
services.desc: Holiday rates apply for Memorial Day (5/21-5/26), July 4th (6/22-7/7), and Labor Day (9/2-9/9)* YOU MUST ENTER B2G2 IN ORDER TO RECEIVE DISCOUNT ON STAYS BEGINNING MONDAY TO FRIDAY. WE CAN NOT DISCOUNT PAID RESERVATIONS IF YOU FORGET TO ENTER DISCOUNT CODE. The APACHE and BLACKFOOT cabins sleep a total of FOUR people comfortably containing a twin bunk bed and a full bed, ½ bathroom, outdoor shower, vanity sink, heating/AC, microwave, refrigerator, Keurig, and open front porch. YOUR LOCK BOX CODE WILL BE TEXTED TO YOU ON THE DAY OF YOUR CHECK IN AT 2:45PM. PLEASE BE SURE TO ENTER YOUR MOBILE NUMBER ACCURATELY TO AVOID BEING LOCKED

explain.meaning: An RV site you drive straight through, so there is no backing in.
A connection at the site for an RV's power, water or sewer.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We offer both full service campsites with electric, water and sewer along with camping sites for pop-ups and tent camping that are equipped with water and electric seasonally from May 1st thru September 30th. Lots vary in size in both non-wooded and wooded sections throughout the park. Electric services are 30 and 50 amp . We offer 5 cabins that will sleep 4-people or 8-people with all of the comforts of home.
